g.text: Schema: Posts, Retweets, and the Index That Isn't a Table
media_url is a pointer, retweets duplicates nothing, and the search index isn't relational at all
fed by outbox from posts + retweets
NOT a table in the relational store --
its own store, partitioned by token
posts + retweets: strongly consistent at write time -- UNIQUE(retweeter_id, original_post_id) is the concurrency guarantee, not app code.
search index: eventually consistent, ~2s -- separate, tighter lag budget than feed_items' own tolerance.
retweets sharded by original_post_id, not retweeter_id -- keeps one viral post's retweets on a single shard.
media (object storage): write-once immutable bytes -- posts.media_url pointer is strongly consistent.
Three stores, three consistency models -- none of them entangled with each other's guarantees.
